purpose: Test whether a policy-independent ready-player anti-hotspot vote can remove the repeated same-function node concentration observed in V163 while preserving V163's throughput-producing frontier and one lifetime speculative credit.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

e09_frontier_evidence.interpretation: The V163 frontier preserves throughput but repeated ready-root placements concentrate on a small warm-container set, raising queue latency. The remaining gap requires lowering latency-cost product rather than admitting more incomplete-parent players.

single_mechanism_change_from_v163.ready_players: add one deterministic anti-hotspot ordinal vote that prefers the smallest recent same-function placement share
unchanged: V163 one non-reusable lifetime speculative credit per request
SRPT request order and critical-path rank definition
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

ready_antihotspot_definition.eligible_player: all direct parents are completed; incomplete-parent speculative and terminal-pipeline-only players are excluded
ready_antihotspot_definition.history: the last at most 64 successfully sent placement decisions for the same function, plus projected assignments in the current solver state
ready_antihotspot_definition.candidate_penalty: fraction of same-function history and current projected assignments placed on the candidate node; smaller is preferred; node ID is the deterministic final tie-break
ready_antihotspot_definition.below_queue8_vote_profile: two Hiku-load-faithful votes plus one OCS-current-demand vote plus one ready anti-hotspot vote
ready_antihotspot_definition.at_or_above_queue8_vote_profile: one OCS-current-demand vote plus one ready anti-hotspot vote
ready_antihotspot_definition.history_update: only after a scheduling command batch is sent successfully
runtime_inputs_forbidden: fitted function IDs, node IDs, time cutoffs or admission counts

checks: exact E09, E18 and E20 product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
V163 lifetime-credit conservation and frontier invariants all remain satisfied
ready anti-hotspot is evaluated only for parents-completed players
at least one ready player has nonempty same-function history and at least one selected node differs from the frozen V163 anchor choice
the registered profile and unit-test receipt prove that every ready-player operational penalty uses the preregistered Borda order for its queue route
all nonready player penalties equal the V163 route
history length never exceeds 64 and updates only after successful command send
both below-8 and at-or-above-8 routes occur
zero performance or aggregate outcome fields are parsed before audit sealing

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V164 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V164 diagnostics, retire V164 and do not run its other seventeen seeds
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-seventeen V164 training plan reusing these three rows
